name: Memos
pitch: A privacy-first, lightweight note-taking service for capturing and sharing ideas.
description_md: Memos is a self-hosted Go application with a web frontend for private notes, knowledge capture, and collaboration. This recipe deploys the pinned upstream release on the provided Amazon Linux 2023 runtime with managed PostgreSQL and managed object storage.

blocked_reasons: The generic web, provided.al2023, and managed object-storage capabilities are not production-ready.
Memos live updates require a cross-instance SSE delivery capability before the service can scale beyond one execution environment.
Memos runs database migrations during startup without cross-instance serialization; production rollout needs a single-writer migration gate.
The pinned recipe has not completed the recorded end-to-end deployment pass.
